name: amberkeep-desktop
description: Use Claude Desktop to turn your synchronized Claude history into an evidence-linked Obsidian knowledge graph.
long_description: Connect to the Amberkeep plugin in an explicitly selected Obsidian vault. Synchronize history, read pending source pages, and save grounded concepts, decisions, and questions with source quotations. The extension connects only to the plugin's authenticated loopback bridge. It needs no API key and does not read Claude Desktop cookies.

tools.name: amberkeep_status
tools.description: Check connection, synchronization, and analysis progress.

tools.name: amberkeep_list_pending
tools.description: List sources that still need semantic analysis.

tools.name: amberkeep_read_source
tools.description: Read a source page with stable message IDs.

tools.name: amberkeep_save_knowledge
tools.description: Save evidence-grounded knowledge from a fully read source.

tools.name: amberkeep_open_graph
tools.description: Open the knowledge graph in Obsidian.

vault_path.title: Obsidian vault
vault_path.description: Choose the vault where the Amberkeep Obsidian plugin is enabled. Keep that vault open while using these tools.
